Ivy T (Finance): Reseller BrightBridge flagged a GCP Marketplace invoice anomaly — duplicate charge lines for May usage, partner says total duplicate = $6,310 (invoice GCP-2026-05-09). Can ops check? :wave:

Liam B (Billing Ops): Please paste their sample lines. If payout still pending we can adjust before settlement. @BillingBot check BrightBridge payout status.

Rashid (Sales): Partner sent this snippet: 
```
line_id,sku,meter_id,usage,charge
G-7781,sku-pro,44100,5000,3155.00
G-7782,sku-pro-legacy,44100,5000,3155.00
```
They claim meter_id 44100 billed twice after our SKU consolidation on 2026-05-01.

BillingBot: Payout status for BrightBridge (partner_id BB-13): scheduled payout 2026-05-20T04:00:00Z, status pending.

Ivy T (Finance): Proposed: hold payout, require partner-signed acceptance of one-time correction, issue manual credit $6,310, GL memo GCP-MP-2026-05-DEDUP, code 4205-REV-CR. Priya sign-off? (cc: Head of Revenue)

Liam B (Billing Ops): Sounds right. Sofia, can legal do a short waiver clause?

Sofia (Legal): Draft: "Partner accepts a one-time correction for duplicated lines on invoice GCP-2026-05-09. Acceptance constitutes full settlement for the corrected lines." I'll send for signature.

Rashid (Sales): Sent amendment; partner signed and uploaded at 2026-05-19T09:20Z.

Liam B (Billing Ops): Applying manual credit now and tagging payout. Posting journal entry: Debit Revenue 4205-REV-CR / Credit AP-Partner 2202, memo GCP-MP-2026-05-DEDUP.

Ivy T (Finance): Confirmed posting. Releasing hold and closing ticket. Note for post-mortem: add reseller propagation verification to SKU consolidation playbook.

BillingBot: Payout updated to reflect credit. No further actions pending.

Rashid (Sales): Partner thanked us for the quick turnaround. Closing loop. :white_check_mark:
